help: run the tests, then every pipeline over data/input/, the one named, or one input item of it - processing only, never acquiring

args.name: pipeline
args.help: one pipeline by name, validated against the pipelines that exist; bare, all of them

args.name: item
args.help: one input item under that pipeline's root, passed to the pipeline's run.sh as --item; bare, the whole root

args.name: --plan
args.help: print the ordered step plan; run nothing

does: reaches PyPI on every run to check for an upgrade - refused, skipped with a note
reaches PyPI when the venv lacks packages - refused, skipped, so a fresh venv then fails at first import, visibly

explanation.stages: the tail's table as facts - each stage the run performed, with its count of failures (every non-zero exit states an atom, so the count is the stage's verdict) and the line where its banner stands in the log, so that a count turns back into the lines that produced it; each pipeline stage runs alone as corpus-yoga pipeline run <stage>, and corpus is the reduce over all
